create_generic_client_interceptor: create a gRPC generic client interceptor using the create factory function with a custom intercept_call
build_unary_unary_interceptor: build a unary-unary gRPC client interceptor that modifies call details and postprocesses responses
build_unary_stream_interceptor: build a unary-stream gRPC client interceptor that intercepts single request streaming response calls
build_stream_unary_interceptor: build a stream-unary gRPC client interceptor that intercepts streaming request single response calls
review_generic_client_interceptor_class: review the _GenericClientInterceptor class that implements all four gRPC client interceptor interfaces
